description: Global food prices climbed sharply around 2010-2011 and raised import exposure concerns for food-importing systems
Severe drought conditions in the Horn of Africa strained regional food systems and raised humanitarian pressure
Commodity prices weakened sharply around 2014-2015 and put pressure on trade balances and public finances
Several SSA economies experienced foreign-exchange and balance-of-payments stress during this period
Mechanization and digital agriculture models gained visibility as productivity interventions across the region
